bar.bonferroni: One-sided t-test on pooled OOS per-trade net returns; p < 0.05 / N_run; N_run = programme executed-trial counter at run time + cells_in_this_declaration. Freeze-time floor per SRS run-prep records: 3,889 executed, SRS cell queued ahead.
bar.breadth: expectancy_net > 0 on at least 2 of 4 instruments (each with >= 20 OOS trades) AND no single instrument contributing more than 80% of total net profit (rd.common.holdout_check construction applied to this panel).
bar.cost_shadow: At 2x costs (12 bps round trip): pooled OOS expectancy_net > 0 AND PF_net >= 1.2.

temporal_holdout_v1.H5_burn_clause: Holdout judged exactly once in the single declared run. Prior computation/inspection of holdout trades or metrics, or any re-run after evaluation with changed rules/parameters/conventions/costs/panel/simulator/judging code, burns the holdout: this element FAILS permanently under this declaration.

cell_accounting: 1 variant x 1 pooled 4-instrument panel x 1 timeframe (M15) = 1 cell. Variants require a new declaration and raise the count.

costs.note: Spread+slippage modelled at 3 bps per side, no separate commission (OANDA practice). Applied adversely in price space on entry and exit.

hypothesis: Probes beyond the completed Asian range during late-Asian/early-London hours are disproportionately false (liquidity grabs ahead of the London move); fading the first touch of an Asian extreme toward the range midpoint, with invalidation a half-range beyond the extreme, earns positive expectancy net of the programme FX-major cost model.

rules.dst_handling: All windows are fixed UTC clock times and never shift for any local DST change. Disclosed: London local open = 07:00 UTC in BST, 08:00 UTC in GMT; Tokyo observes no DST. Same fixed-UTC construction as RD-003 london_drive.
rules.entry: Open of the bar immediately following the touch bar. Guards (a failed guard voids the day's only setup): entry bar must start before 10:00 UTC; SHORT requires stop_price > entry_open > target_price; LONG requires stop_price < entry_open < target_price.
rules.exit: First of target touched / stop touched / time exit at the open of the bar starting at 10:00 UTC. Evaluated on bars from the entry (fill) bar onward; within a bar touching both, the stop fills first (worst case).
rules.one_position_per_session: At most one trade per instrument per UTC date; the first touch defines the day's only setup; no re-entry.
rules.range_definition: high = max high, low = min low over the bars starting in [00:00, 06:00) UTC of the UTC calendar date; frozen at 06:00 UTC; zero-height range -> no setup
rules.stop: SHORT: range_high + 0.5 * W; LONG: range_low - 0.5 * W; W = range_high - range_low. Fixed at entry.
rules.touch: First fade-window bar with high >= range high -> SHORT fade; first with low <= range low -> LONG fade. A bar touching both extremes -> no setup that day.
rules.tradeable_day: All 40 bars starting in [00:00, 10:00) UTC present, complete and contiguous (15-minute spacing), and the bar starting at 10:00 UTC present. Otherwise no setup that day for that instrument. No filling or interpolation.

run_queue: One declared run at a time; this family runs only on coordinator order, behind SRS (TASK-IG2-STR-14) and S-RD1 (TASK-IG2-STR-19).
sizing: Not part of the family identity; judged on per-trade net returns. Forward testing, if ever reached, inherits the FWD-006 package unchanged (0.1% per-trade risk on venue equity, 2% heat cap). Demo only; live trading prohibited.

verdicts.delete: Pooled OOS PF_net < 1.2 (strict) -> family FAILS and is deleted completely (owner removal rule).
verdicts.fail: Any other bar element failing -> FAIL, family closes.
verdicts.insufficient: Pooled OOS trades < 200 -> verdict is exactly 'insufficient OOS trades'; not proven, not promoted; the bar is never relaxed to fit the panel.
verdicts.proven: ALL bar elements pass -> forward-test candidate under the Phase-3 protocol (demo only).
